text: 6 Nov 2026 The recent AI sell-off brought a lot of fearmongering headlines. Put next to past stock market crashes, it's only a mild correction for the S&P 500, 6 % below its record. Tech fell harder, with the Nasdaq down 11 % and chip stocks down 36 % , as much as they fell during Covid (35%) . We'll be tracking the sell-off here with daily data updates. Each line runs from a record high to the low that followed. Eight of the 16 falls past 15% since 1928 are shown. Daily closes to 6 Nov 2026 All 56 falls of 6% or more from a record since 1928, one dot each at its lowest point. How far each index is below its record now, against the lows of its own best-known past falls. US chip stocks (the PHLX Semiconductor index) are 36% down from their 22 Jun record, as deep as their Covid fall.
